The '''Canoliss system''' was located in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Canoliss IV]], home to the [[Cannolite]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Tricks" />
